name: Sodium Hydroxide
description: A strong alkali widely used in laboratories, soap manufacturing, and chemical processing.
storage: Store in tightly sealed containers away from acids and moisture.
first_aid: Flush affected area with water for at least 15 minutes and seek medical attention.
disposal: Dispose as hazardous chemical waste according to local regulations.
green_alternative: Use milder alkaline cleaners where suitable.
environmental_impact: Can increase the pH of water bodies if released untreated.

name: Potassium Hydroxide
description: A strong alkali commonly used in laboratories and industrial chemical production.
storage: Store in airtight containers away from acids and moisture.
first_aid: Flush with water for at least 15 minutes and obtain medical attention.
disposal: Dispose through approved hazardous waste procedures.
green_alternative: Use less concentrated alkaline solutions when appropriate.

name: Calcium Hydroxide
description: A moderately strong base used in laboratories, construction, and water treatment.
storage: Store in a dry, sealed container.
first_aid: Wash affected area thoroughly with water.
green_alternative: Often considered an environmentally acceptable treatment chemical when properly used.
environmental_impact: Can increase soil and water alkalinity if overused.

name: Ammonium Hydroxide
description: A solution of ammonia in water used in laboratories and cleaning applications.
storage: Store tightly closed in a cool, ventilated area.
first_aid: Move to fresh air if inhaled and flush exposed skin with water.
disposal: Dispose through approved hazardous waste procedures.
green_alternative: Use biodegradable cleaning products when suitable.
environmental_impact: Can be harmful to aquatic organisms in high concentrations.

name: Magnesium Hydroxide
description: A weak base commonly used as an antacid and in laboratory applications.
hazards: Low hazard under normal laboratory use
disposal: Dispose according to local laboratory regulations.
green_alternative: Already considered environmentally friendly in many applications.
environmental_impact: Minimal environmental impact when properly handled.

name: Barium Hydroxide
description: A strong base used in laboratories and analytical chemistry.
storage: Store in tightly sealed containers away from acids.
first_aid: Seek immediate medical attention after exposure.
green_alternative: Use less hazardous alkaline compounds where suitable.
environmental_impact: Can be toxic to aquatic life.

name: Lithium Hydroxide
description: A strong alkali commonly used in battery manufacturing and laboratory research.
first_aid: Flush exposed area with water and seek medical attention.
disposal: Dispose through approved hazardous waste facilities.
green_alternative: Use less hazardous absorbents when suitable.
environmental_impact: Can affect water alkalinity if improperly disposed.

name: Sodium Carbonate
description: A common alkaline salt used in laboratories, cleaning, and water softening.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place.
green_alternative: Already widely accepted as an environmentally safer cleaning chemical.
environmental_impact: Low environmental impact when properly used.

name: Sodium Bicarbonate
description: A mild alkaline compound widely used in laboratories, food processing, and environmental applications.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place.

name: Potassium Carbonate
description: An alkaline salt used in laboratories, glass manufacturing, and detergents.
storage: Keep container tightly closed in a dry place.
green_alternative: Use milder alkaline cleaners where suitable.
environmental_impact: Low environmental impact when properly handled.

name: Calcium Carbonate
description: A naturally occurring alkaline compound commonly used in laboratories and construction.

name: Magnesium Carbonate
description: A naturally occurring carbonate used in laboratories and industrial applications.

name: Sodium Phosphate
description: A strong alkaline cleaning and laboratory chemical.
environmental_impact: Excess phosphate can contribute to algal blooms.

name: Potassium Phosphate
description: An alkaline phosphate compound used in laboratories and food processing.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place.
environmental_impact: Can contribute to nutrient pollution if released in large quantities.

name: Sodium Metasilicate
description: A strongly alkaline silicate used in detergents, cleaning products, and laboratories.
storage: Store in tightly sealed containers away from acids.
first_aid: Flush exposed area with water for at least 15 minutes.
disposal: Dispose as hazardous waste according to regulations.
green_alternative: Use biodegradable cleaning products where appropriate.
environmental_impact: May increase water alkalinity if improperly released.
